accepted.title: You have joined {organization}
accepted.description: Your membership is active. Your email address is confirmed at the same time: the link has just proved it.
accepted.createAccountHint: All that is left is choosing a password to open your account.

expired.title: This invitation has expired
expired.description: The link is no longer valid. Ask the person who wrote to you for a new invitation: they can send it again from their organization's workspace.

already_used.title: This invitation has already been accepted
already_used.description: You are part of this organization: there is nothing more to do here.

invalid.title: This invitation is not valid
invalid.description: Your email software may have broken the link: open it from the message rather than copying it out.

notYours.title: This invitation is for someone else
notYours.description: You are signed in with an account other than the one that received this link. Sign out to accept it.

empty.title: No invitation to open
empty.description: This page confirms a membership from the link received by email. Open that link from your mailbox.
